audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Incorrect O3 changes the original PDE and prevents the stated Cartesian cancellation.; Local mapping estimate omits nonlocal top trace; uniform C2alpha constant omits higher-norm bound M.; Strict same-sign normal derivative assertion fails when the allowed density is zero.
limitations: Counterevidence: Corrected coefficient restores cancellation; small gradients make correction quadratic. No global free-boundary counterexample or false main theorem established.
Counterevidence: Later globally controlled sequences have the missing trace control; no counterexample to compactness of a correctly defined map.
Counterevidence: Positive density on both sides restores sign via Rankine-Hugoniot; vanishing flux would force equal full gradients. Main nonvacuum angle range excludes the example.

Counterevidence: Dvarphi2 restores the vanishing correction and the existing bounds yield the intended positivity. This is a repair, not validation of the original identity or a counterexample to the regularity conclusion.
Counterevidence: Normal solution satisfies target norm bound with zero perturbation; strict positivity can be separated to nonzero parameters.

Counterevidence: The corrected derivative identity and existing derivative/corner bounds restore the endpoint argument. MVT already supplies F'(xm)->0; in5.6 bounded factors multiply psi_xy->0. These preserve the intended limits without validating the false identity.
Counterevidence: Correct speed bound unchanged; Lipschitz small-neighborhood argument accommodates correct factor2.
Limitations: The exact v1 author manuscript and unexamined publisher version are not assumed equivalent.
Limitations: The separate extended-iteration ellipticity candidate remains unresolved, not a confirmed finding; no admissible global counterexample was constructed.
Limitations: External mixed-boundary, degenerate Schauder and convexity results were not independently reproved.
Limitations: No author code was run; historical reviewer calculations retain their original attribution.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Incorrect O3 changes the original PDE and prevents the stated Cartesian cancellation.

Local mapping estimate omits nonlocal top trace; uniform C2alpha constant omits higher-norm bound M.

Strict same-sign normal derivative assertion fails when the allowed density is zero.

Normalized gradient in radial comparison should be Dvarphi2, not Dvarphi.

Strict positivity fails at normal base point; pullback has wrong quadratic sign.

Chain-rule factors/signs and exact-zero conclusion of mean value theorem are wrong.

Sound-speed equality and a factor in the Bernoulli difference are incorrect.
